WITH base_igm AS (
         SELECT retail_order_igm.network_order_id
           FROM analytics_insight.retail_order_igm
          WHERE
                CASE
                    WHEN NOT retail_order_igm.issue_sync_response IS DISTINCT FROM 'NACK'::text OR COALESCE(TRIM(BOTH FROM retail_order_igm.on_issue_error_code), ''::text) <> ''::text THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END = 1
          GROUP BY retail_order_igm.network_order_id
        )
 SELECT ol."Buyer NP",
    ol."Seller NP",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."Date" >= (CURRENT_DATE - '6 mons'::interval) THEN ol."Network order id"
            ELSE NULL::character varying
        END AS "Network order id",
    lower((ol."Seller NP"::text || '_'::text) || ol."Provider Id"::text) AS "provider key",
    ol."Provider Id",
    ol."Seller Name",
    ol."Seller Pincode",
    ol."Delivery Pincode",
    ol.cancellation_code,
    ol."Created at",
    ol."Date",
        CASE
            WHEN lo.retail_order_id IS NULL THEN 'Off Network'::text
            ELSE 'On Network'::text
        END AS logistics_type,
    ol.domain,
    ol."on-time-del",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."Date" >= (CURRENT_DATE - '6 mons'::interval) THEN date_trunc('minute'::text, ol."Shipped at")
            ELSE NULL::timestamp without time zone
        END AS "Shipped at",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."Date" >= (CURRENT_DATE - '6 mons'::interval) THEN date_trunc('minute'::text, ol."Ready to Ship")
            ELSE NULL::timestamp without time zone
        END AS "Ready to Ship",
    ol."Promised time",
    ol.tat_dif,
    ol.tat_diff_days,
    ol.day_diff,
    ol.min_diff,
    ol.tat_time,
    ol.no_key,
    ol."ONDC order_status",
    ol."Updated at",
    ol."Category",
    ol."Consolidated_category",
    ol.c_context_timestamp,
    ol.is_force_cancelled,
        CASE
            WHEN (ol."Promised time" - ol."Created at") > '24:00:00'::interval THEN '>24'::text
            WHEN (ol."Promised time" - ol."Created at") <= '24:00:00'::interval THEN '<=24'::text
            ELSE 'Undefined'::text
        END AS "PTAT_Threshold",
        CASE
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM base_igm b
              WHERE b.network_order_id = ol."Network order id"::text)) THEN 'yes'::text
            ELSE 'no'::text
        END AS order_with_atleast_one_issue
   FROM analytics_insight.order_level ol
     LEFT JOIN logistics.linked_order_id lo ON ol."Network order id"::text = lo.retail_order_id::text;

WITH base_igm AS (
         SELECT retail_order_igm.network_order_id,
            min(retail_order_igm.ticket_created_date) AS first_issue_creation_date,
            sum(retail_order_igm."ticket count") AS ticket_count
           FROM analytics_insight.retail_order_igm
          WHERE
                CASE
                    WHEN retail_order_igm.issue_sync_response = 'NACK'::text OR TRIM(BOTH FROM retail_order_igm.on_issue_error_code) <> ''::text OR retail_order_igm.on_issue_error_code IS NOT NULL THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END = 0
          GROUP BY retail_order_igm.network_order_id
        )
 SELECT ol."Buyer NP",
    ol."Seller NP",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."Date" >= (CURRENT_DATE - '6 mons'::interval) THEN ol."Network order id"
            ELSE NULL::character varying
        END AS "Network order id",
    lower((ol."Seller NP"::text || '_'::text) || ol."Provider Id"::text) AS "provider key",
    ol."Provider Id",
    ol."Seller Name",
    ol."Seller Pincode",
    ol."Delivery Pincode",
    ol.cancellation_code,
    date_trunc('minute'::text, ol."Created at") AS "Created at",
    ol."Date",
        CASE
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM logistics.linked_order_id lo
              WHERE ol."Network order id"::text = lo.retail_order_id::text)) THEN 'On Network'::text
            ELSE 'Off Network'::text
        END AS logistics_type,
    ol.domain,
    ol."on-time-del",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."Date" >= (CURRENT_DATE - '6 mons'::interval) THEN date_trunc('minute'::text, ol."Shipped at")
            ELSE NULL::timestamp without time zone
        END AS "Shipped at",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."Date" >= (CURRENT_DATE - '6 mons'::interval) THEN date_trunc('minute'::text, ol."Ready to Ship")
            ELSE NULL::timestamp without time zone
        END AS "Ready to Ship",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."Date" >= (CURRENT_DATE - '6 mons'::interval) THEN date_trunc('minute'::text, ol.f_agent_assigned_at)
            ELSE NULL::timestamp without time zone
        END AS "agent assigned at",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."Date" >= (CURRENT_DATE - '6 mons'::interval) THEN date_trunc('minute'::text, ol.f_rto_initiated_at)
            ELSE NULL::timestamp without time zone
        END AS "rto initiated at",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."Date" >= (CURRENT_DATE - '6 mons'::interval) THEN date_trunc('minute'::text, ol.f_rto_delivered_at)
            ELSE NULL::timestamp without time zone
        END AS "rto delivered at",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."Date" >= (CURRENT_DATE - '6 mons'::interval) THEN date_trunc('minute'::text, ol.f_rto_requested_at)
            ELSE NULL::timestamp without time zone
        END AS "rto requested at",
    date_trunc('minute'::text, ol."Promised time") AS "Promised time",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'In Process'::text THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM CURRENT_DATE::timestamp without time zone - ol."Promised time")::bigint::double precision
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Cancelled'::text THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM ol."Updated at" - ol."Promised time")::bigint::double precision
            ELSE ol.tat_dif
        END AS tat_dif,
        CASE
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'In Process'::text THEN (CURRENT_DATE - ol."Promised time"::date)::double precision
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Cancelled'::text THEN (ol."Updated at"::date - ol."Promised time"::date)::double precision
            ELSE ol.tat_diff_days
        END AS tat_diff_days,
        CASE
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'In Process'::text THEN (CURRENT_DATE - ol."Created at"::date)::double precision
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Cancelled'::text THEN (ol."Updated at"::date - ol."Created at"::date)::double precision
            ELSE ol.day_diff
        END AS day_diff,
        CASE
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'In Process'::text THEN (EXTRACT(epoch FROM CURRENT_DATE::timestamp without time zone - ol."Created at") / 60::numeric)::integer::double precision
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Cancelled'::text THEN (EXTRACT(epoch FROM ol."Updated at" - ol."Created at") / 60::numeric)::integer::double precision
            ELSE ol.min_diff
        END AS min_diff,
    ol.tat_time,
    ol.no_key,
    ol."ONDC order_status",
    date_trunc('minute'::text, ol."Updated at") AS "Updated at",
    ol."Category",
    ol."Consolidated_category",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."Category"::text = 'F&B'::text THEN 'F&B'::text
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM dimension.dim_provider_cred pc
              WHERE pc.provider_key = lower((ol."Seller NP"::text || '_'::text) || ol."Provider Id"::text))) THEN 'Amazing India'::text
            WHEN ol."Category"::text = ANY (ARRAY['Grocery'::text, 'Appliances'::text, 'BPC'::text, 'Fashion'::text, 'Health & Wellness'::text, 'Home & Kitchen'::text, 'Electronics'::text]) THEN 'RET+'::text
            ELSE 'Others'::text
        END AS aop_category,
    date_trunc('minute'::text, ol.c_context_timestamp) AS c_context_timestamp,
    ol.is_force_cancelled,
        CASE
            WHEN (ol."Promised time" - ol."Created at") >= '24:00:00'::interval THEN '>=24'::text
            WHEN (ol."Promised time" - ol."Created at") < '24:00:00'::interval THEN '<24'::text
            ELSE 'Undefined'::text
        END AS "PTAT_Threshold",
    b.ticket_count AS total_issues_raised,
    date_trunc('minute'::text, b.first_issue_creation_date) AS first_issue_creation_date,
        CASE
            WHEN ol."Updated at" > ol."Promised time" THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS absolute_breach,
        CASE
            WHEN CURRENT_DATE > ol."Promised time"::date THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_pat_breached,
        CASE
            WHEN CURRENT_DATE::timestamp without time zone > ol."Promised time" THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_promised_time_breached,
        CASE
            WHEN ol."Date" >= (CURRENT_DATE - '6 mons'::interval) THEN date_trunc('minute'::text, COALESCE(ol."Ready to Ship", ol."Shipped at",
            CASE
                WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Delivered'::text THEN ol."Updated at"
                ELSE NULL::timestamp without time zone
            END))
            ELSE NULL::timestamp without time zone
        END AS "Ready to Ship Filled",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."Date" >= (CURRENT_DATE - '6 mons'::interval) THEN date_trunc('minute'::text, COALESCE(ol.f_agent_assigned_at, ol."Shipped at",
            CASE
                WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Delivered'::text THEN ol."Updated at"
                ELSE NULL::timestamp without time zone
            END))
            ELSE NULL::timestamp without time zone
        END AS "agent assigned at Filled",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."Date" >= (CURRENT_DATE - '6 mons'::interval) THEN date_trunc('minute'::text, COALESCE(ol."Shipped at",
            CASE
                WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Delivered'::text THEN ol."Updated at"
                ELSE NULL::timestamp without time zone
            END))
            ELSE NULL::timestamp without time zone
        END AS "Shipped at Filled"
   FROM analytics_insight.order_level ol
     LEFT JOIN base_igm b ON ol."Network order id"::text = b.network_order_id
  WHERE ol."Date" >= '2026-01-01'::date;

     LEFT JOIN analytics_insight.buyer_np bnp ON ol."Buyer NP"::text = bnp.buyer_np::text

    COALESCE(sp.tier, 'Undefined'::character varying) AS "Seller Tier",
    COALESCE(dp.tier, 'Undefined'::character varying) AS "Delivery Tier",
    COALESCE(sp.zones, 'Undefined'::character varying) AS "Seller Zone",
    COALESCE(dp.zones, 'Undefined'::character varying) AS "Delivery Zone",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."Category"::text = 'F&B'::text THEN 'Hyperlocal'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(dp.districtname, 'Undefined'::character varying)::text = 'Undefined'::text THEN 'Undefined'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(sp.districtname, 'Undefined'::character varying)::text = 'Undefined'::text THEN 'Undefined'::text
            WHEN dp.districtname::text <> sp.districtname::text THEN 'Intercity'::text
            ELSE 'Hyperlocal'::text
        END AS "Delivery Type",
        CASE
            WHEN bnp.buyer_np::text <> snp.seller_np::text THEN 'Inter NP'::text
            ELSE 'Intra NP'::text
        END AS "Order type",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Delivered'::text AND ol."Updated at" > ol."Promised time" THEN 1
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Cancelled'::text AND ol."Updated at" > ol."Promised time" THEN 1
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'In Process'::text AND CURRENT_DATE > ol."Promised time"::date THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS "Breach",
    cc.attributed_to,
    cc.reason_for_cancellation,
    cc.is_triggers_rto,
    cc.by AS cancelled_by,
    cc.whether_applicable_for_part_cancel,
    cc.sorting,
        CASE
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Cancelled'::text AND cc.attributed_to::text = 'Buyer app'::text THEN ol.no_key
            ELSE 0
        END AS "Buyer cancel",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Cancelled'::text AND cc.attributed_to::text = 'Seller app'::text THEN ol.no_key
            ELSE 0
        END AS "Seller cancel",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Cancelled'::text AND cc.attributed_to::text = 'Logistics Provider'::text THEN ol.no_key
            ELSE 0
        END AS "Logistic cancel",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Cancelled'::text THEN cc.attributed_to
            ELSE NULL::character varying
        END AS "Cancelled att"
   FROM analytics_insight.order_level ol
     LEFT JOIN analytics_insight.seller_np snp ON ol."Seller NP"::text = snp.seller_np::text
     LEFT JOIN analytics_insight.buyer_np bnp ON ol."Buyer NP"::text = bnp.buyer_np::text
     LEFT JOIN analytics_insight.pincode sp ON ol."Seller Pincode"::text = sp.pincode::text
     LEFT JOIN analytics_insight.pincode dp ON ol."Delivery Pincode"::text = dp.pincode::text
     LEFT JOIN analytics_insight.cancellation_code cc ON ol.cancellation_code::text = cc.code::text;

            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = ANY (ARRAY['Delivered'::character varying::text, 'Cancelled'::character varying::text]) THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM ol."Updated at" - ol."Promised time") / 60.0

            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS "Breach (mins)",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = ANY (ARRAY['Delivered'::character varying::text, 'Cancelled'::character varying::text]) THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM ol."Updated at" - ol."Promised time") / 3600.0
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'In Process'::text THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - ol."Promised time"::timestamp with time zone) / 3600.0
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS "Breach (hrs)",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = ANY (ARRAY['Delivered'::character varying::text, 'Cancelled'::character varying::text]) THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM ol."Updated at" - ol."Promised time") / 86400.0
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'In Process'::text THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - ol."Promised time"::timestamp with time zone) / 86400.0
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS "Breach (days)",

            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Delivered'::text AND ol.tat_dif > 21600::double precision AND ol.tat_dif <= 43200::double precision THEN ol.no_key
            ELSE 0
        END AS "TAT 6-12 hrs",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Delivered'::text AND ol.tat_dif > 43200::double precision AND ol.tat_dif <= 86400::double precision THEN ol.no_key
            ELSE 0
        END AS "TAT 12-24 hrs",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Delivered'::text AND ol.tat_dif > 86400::double precision AND ol.tat_dif <= 172800::double precision THEN ol.no_key
            ELSE 0
        END AS "TAT 24-48 hrs",

            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Delivered'::text AND ol.tat_dif > 172800::double precision THEN ol.no_key
            ELSE 0

            ELSE 0

            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Delivered'::text AND ol.tat_diff_days = 2::double precision THEN ol.no_key

            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Delivered'::text AND ol.tat_diff_days = 3::double precision THEN ol.no_key
            ELSE 0

            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Delivered'::text AND ol.tat_diff_days = 4::double precision THEN ol.no_key
            ELSE 0

            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS "Non F&B days diff",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."Shipped at" IS NOT NULL THEN ol.no_key
            ELSE 0
        END AS "Shipped mark",
    sp.statename AS "Seller State",
    dp.statename AS "Delivery State",
    COALESCE(sp.districtname, 'Undefined'::character varying) AS "Seller City",
    COALESCE(dp.districtname, 'Undefined'::character varying) AS "Delivery City",
    COALESCE(sp.tier, 'Undefined'::character varying) AS "Seller Tier",
    COALESCE(dp.tier, 'Undefined'::character varying) AS "Delivery Tier",
    COALESCE(sp.zones, 'Undefined'::character varying) AS "Seller Zone",
    COALESCE(dp.zones, 'Undefined'::character varying) AS "Delivery Zone",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."Category"::text = 'F&B'::text THEN 'Hyperlocal'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(dp.districtname, 'Undefined'::character varying)::text = 'Undefined'::text THEN 'Undefined'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(sp.districtname, 'Undefined'::character varying)::text = 'Undefined'::text THEN 'Undefined'::text
            WHEN dp.districtname::text <> sp.districtname::text THEN 'Intercity'::text
            ELSE 'Hyperlocal'::text
        END AS "Delivery Type",
        CASE
            WHEN bnp.buyer_np_name::text <> snp.seller_np_name::text THEN 'Inter NP'::text
            ELSE 'Intra NP'::text
        END AS "Order type",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."Date" < '2023-11-01'::date THEN NULL::integer
            WHEN
            CASE
                WHEN ol."Category"::text = 'F&B'::text THEN 'Hyperlocal'::text
                WHEN COALESCE(dp.districtname, 'Undefined'::character varying)::text = 'Undefined'::text THEN 'Undefined'::text
                WHEN COALESCE(sp.districtname, 'Undefined'::character varying)::text = 'Undefined'::text THEN 'Undefined'::text
                WHEN dp.districtname::text <> sp.districtname::text THEN 'Intercity'::text
                ELSE 'Hyperlocal'::text
            END = 'Intercity'::text THEN
            CASE
                WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Delivered'::text AND ol."Updated at"::date > ol."Promised time"::date THEN 1
                WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Cancelled'::text AND cc.attributed_to::text = 'Buyer app'::text AND ol."Updated at"::date > ol."Promised time"::date THEN 1
                WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'In Process'::text AND ol."Date" >= '2024-02-01'::date AND CURRENT_DATE > ol."Promised time"::date THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
            ELSE
            CASE
                WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Delivered'::text AND ol."Updated at"::date > ol."Promised time"::date THEN 1
                WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Cancelled'::text AND cc.attributed_to::text = 'Buyer app'::text AND ol."Updated at"::date > ol."Promised time"::date THEN 1
                WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'In Process'::text AND ol."Date" >= '2024-02-01'::date AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP > ol."Promised time" THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        END AS "Breach",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text <> 'In Process'::text THEN 0
            WHEN ol."Date" < '2023-11-01'::date THEN 0
            WHEN
            CASE
                WHEN ol."Category"::text = 'F&B'::text THEN 'Hyperlocal'::text
                WHEN COALESCE(dp.districtname, 'Undefined'::character varying)::text = 'Undefined'::text THEN 'Undefined'::text
                WHEN COALESCE(sp.districtname, 'Undefined'::character varying)::text = 'Undefined'::text THEN 'Undefined'::text
                WHEN dp.districtname::text <> sp.districtname::text THEN 'Intercity'::text
                ELSE 'Hyperlocal'::text
            END = 'Intercity'::text THEN
            CASE
                WHEN ol."Date" >= '2024-02-01'::date AND CURRENT_DATE > ol."Promised time"::date THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
            ELSE
            CASE
                WHEN ol."Date" >= '2024-02-01'::date AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP > ol."Promised time" THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        END AS "Inprocessnew(tat)",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text <> 'In Process'::text THEN 0
            WHEN ol."Date" < '2024-02-01'::date THEN 0
            WHEN
            CASE
                WHEN ol."Category"::text = 'F&B'::text THEN 'Hyperlocal'::text
                WHEN COALESCE(dp.districtname, 'Undefined'::character varying)::text = 'Undefined'::text THEN 'Undefined'::text
                WHEN COALESCE(sp.districtname, 'Undefined'::character varying)::text = 'Undefined'::text THEN 'Undefined'::text
                WHEN dp.districtname::text <> sp.districtname::text THEN 'Intercity'::text
                ELSE 'Hyperlocal'::text
            END = 'Intercity'::text THEN
            CASE
                WHEN CURRENT_DATE > ol."Promised time"::date THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
            ELSE
            CASE
                WHEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP > ol."Promised time" THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        END AS "inprocess(tat)",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text <> 'Cancelled'::text THEN 0
            WHEN cc.attributed_to IS NULL OR (cc.attributed_to::text <> ALL (ARRAY['Buyer App'::text, 'Buyer app'::text])) THEN 0
            WHEN ol."Date" < '2023-11-01'::date THEN 0
            WHEN ol."Updated at"::date > ol."Promised time"::date THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS "Buyer cancelled(tat)",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text <> 'Cancelled'::text THEN 0
            WHEN cc.attributed_to IS NULL OR cc.attributed_to::text <> 'Logistics Provider'::text THEN 0
            WHEN ol."Date" < '2023-11-01'::date THEN 0
            WHEN ol."Updated at"::date > ol."Promised time"::date THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS "Logistics cancelled(tat)",
    cc.attributed_to,
    cc.reason_for_cancellation,
    cc.is_triggers_rto,
    cc.by AS cancelled_by,
    cc.whether_applicable_for_part_cancel,
    cc.sorting,
        CASE
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Cancelled'::text AND cc.attributed_to::text = 'Buyer App'::text THEN ol.no_key
            ELSE 0
        END AS "Buyer Cancel",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Cancelled'::text AND cc.attributed_to::text = 'Seller App'::text THEN ol.no_key
            ELSE 0
        END AS "Seller Cancel",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Cancelled'::text AND cc.attributed_to::text = 'Logistics Provider'::text THEN ol.no_key
            ELSE 0
        END AS "Logistics Cancel",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Cancelled'::text THEN cc.attributed_to
            ELSE NULL::character varying
        END AS "Cancelled att",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'In Process'::text AND ol."Updated at" >= '2024-02-01'::date THEN ol.no_key
            ELSE 0
        END AS "In Process (Dt)",
        CASE
            WHEN ol."ONDC order_status"::text = 'Delivered'::text AND ol."Updated at" > ol."Promised time" THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS "delivered(tat)",
        CASE
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM dimension.dim_provider_cred pc
              WHERE pc.provider_key = lower((ol."Seller NP"::text || '_'::text) || ol."Provider Id"::text) AND pc.cred_code = 'Social Sector'::text)) THEN ol.no_key
            ELSE 0
        END AS "Social Cred Orders",
    ol.network_transaction_id,
    ol.f_agent_assigned_at,
    ol.f_rto_initiated_at,
    ol.f_rto_delivered_at,
    ol.f_rto_requested_at
   FROM analytics_insight.order_level ol
     LEFT JOIN dimension.dim_retail_seller_np snp ON ol."Seller NP"::text = snp.seller_np::text
     LEFT JOIN dimension.dim_retail_buyer_np bnp ON ol."Buyer NP"::text = bnp.buyer_np::text
     LEFT JOIN dimension.dim_pincode sp ON ol."Seller Pincode"::text = sp.pincode::text
     LEFT JOIN dimension.dim_pincode dp ON ol."Delivery Pincode"::text = dp.pincode::text
     LEFT JOIN dimension.dim_cancellation_code cc ON ol.cancellation_code::text = cc.code::text;

    (f.max_trans_type_sp >= 1 AND f.max_trans_type_sp <= 6 AND lower(TRIM(BOTH FROM f.is_error)) = 'yes'::text AND f.max_error_trans_type_sp = f.max_trans_type_sp)::integer AS "Drop due to Error (Select-Confirm) (absolute)",
    (f.max_trans_type_sp >= 1 AND f.max_trans_type_sp <= 6 AND lower(TRIM(BOTH FROM f.is_error)) = 'yes'::text AND TRIM(BOTH FROM ecc.category) = 'Inventory'::text AND f.max_trans_type_sp = f.max_error_trans_type_sp)::integer AS "Drop due to Error (Select-Confirm) (inventory) absolute",

   FROM analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2 f
     LEFT JOIN dimension.dim_error_code_category ecc ON TRIM(BOTH FROM f.error_code) = TRIM(BOTH FROM ecc.error_code)
     LEFT JOIN dimension.dim_retail_seller_np snp ON f.bpp_id = snp.seller_np::text
     LEFT JOIN dimension.dim_retail_buyer_np bnp ON f.bap_id = bnp.buyer_np::text

     LEFT JOIN dimension.dim_pincode dp ON f.delivery_pincode = dp.pincode::text;

SELECT igm.bap_id,
    igm.bpp_id,
    igm.ticket_created_date,
    igm."Date",
    igm.domain,
    igm.network_issue_id,
    igm.ticket_category,
    igm.ticket_sub_category,
    igm.ticket_sub_cat,
    igm."Resolved",
    igm.network_order_id,
    igm.ticket_key,
    igm.ticket_source,
    igm."ticket count",
    igm.ticket_raiser,
    igm.ticket_expected_resolution_time,
    igm.ticket_status,
    igm."Closed date",
    igm.r_action_ticket_resolved_date,
    igm.category,
    igm."Order Date",
    igm.seller_name,
    igm.provider_id,
    igm.on_issue_error_code,
    igm.issue_sync_response,
    igm."tat_diff(open)",
    igm."sec_diff(open)",
    igm."min_diff(resolved)",
    igm."tat_diff(res)",
    snp.seller_np_name AS "Seller NP",
    bnp.buyer_np_name AS "Buyer NP",
        CASE
            WHEN NOT igm.issue_sync_response IS DISTINCT FROM 'NACK'::text OR COALESCE(TRIM(BOTH FROM igm.on_issue_error_code), ''::text) <> ''::text THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS rejected,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT igm.issue_sync_response IS DISTINCT FROM 'NACK'::text OR COALESCE(TRIM(BOTH FROM igm.on_issue_error_code), ''::text) <> ''::text THEN igm."ticket count"
            ELSE 0
        END AS "Rejected Retail",
        CASE
            WHEN NOT (NOT igm.issue_sync_response IS DISTINCT FROM 'NACK'::text OR COALESCE(TRIM(BOTH FROM igm.on_issue_error_code), ''::text) <> ''::text) THEN igm."ticket count"
            ELSE 0
        END AS "Ticket_new_count",
        CASE
            WHEN igm.issue_sync_response = 'NACK'::text THEN igm."ticket count"
            ELSE 0
        END AS "NACK Retail",
        CASE
            WHEN igm.issue_sync_response = 'ACK'::text THEN igm."ticket count"
            ELSE 0
        END AS "ACK Retail",
        CASE
            WHEN igm.on_issue_error_code IS NOT NULL OR igm.on_issue_error_code <> ''::text THEN igm."ticket count"
            ELSE 0
        END AS "On_Issue Error Retail",
        CASE
            WHEN igm."Resolved" = 'Yes'::text THEN igm."ticket count"
            ELSE 0
        END AS resolved_ticket,
        CASE
            WHEN igm."Resolved" = 'No'::text THEN igm."ticket count"
            ELSE 0
        END AS unresolved_ticket,
        CASE
            WHEN igm."Resolved" = 'Forced Resolved'::text THEN igm."ticket count"
            ELSE 0
        END AS forced_resolved_ticket,
        CASE
            WHEN igm."Resolved" = 'No'::text AND igm.ticket_status <> 'CLOSED'::text THEN igm."ticket count"
            ELSE 0
        END AS "Unresolved and not closed",
        CASE
            WHEN igm."Resolved" = 'Yes'::text AND igm."tat_diff(res)" <= 0 THEN igm."ticket count"
            ELSE 0
        END AS "Resolution within TAT",
        CASE
            WHEN igm."Resolved" = 'No'::text AND igm."tat_diff(open)" <= 0 THEN igm."ticket count"
            ELSE 0
        END AS "No Resolution & within TAT",
        CASE
            WHEN igm."Resolved" = 'No'::text AND igm."tat_diff(open)" > 0 THEN igm."ticket count"
            ELSE 0
        END AS "No Resolution & outside TAT",
        CASE
            WHEN igm."Resolved" = 'Yes'::text AND igm."min_diff(resolved)" >= 0 AND igm."min_diff(resolved)" <= 86400 THEN igm."ticket count"
            ELSE 0
        END AS "Resolved Ticket (0–1 day) (Retail)",
        CASE
            WHEN igm."Resolved" = 'Yes'::text AND igm."min_diff(resolved)" > 86400 AND igm."min_diff(resolved)" <= 259200 THEN igm."ticket count"
            ELSE 0
        END AS "Resolved Ticket (1–3 day) (Retail)",
        CASE
            WHEN igm."Resolved" = 'Yes'::text AND igm."min_diff(resolved)" > 259200 AND igm."min_diff(resolved)" <= 432000 THEN igm."ticket count"
            ELSE 0
        END AS "Resolved Ticket (3–5 day) (Retail)",
        CASE
            WHEN igm."Resolved" = 'Yes'::text AND igm."min_diff(resolved)" > 432000 AND igm."min_diff(resolved)" <= 864000 THEN igm."ticket count"
            ELSE 0
        END AS "Resolved Ticket(5-10 day) (Retail)",
        CASE
            WHEN igm."Resolved" = 'Yes'::text AND igm."min_diff(resolved)" > 864000 THEN igm."ticket count"
            ELSE 0
        END AS "Resolved Ticket (Above 10 days) (Retail)",
        CASE
            WHEN igm."Resolved" = 'No'::text AND igm."sec_diff(open)" > 0 AND igm."sec_diff(open)" <= 86400 THEN igm."ticket count"
            ELSE 0
        END AS "Unresolved Ticket (0–1 day) (Retail)",
        CASE
            WHEN igm."Resolved" = 'No'::text AND igm."sec_diff(open)" > 86400 AND igm."sec_diff(open)" <= 259200 THEN igm."ticket count"
            ELSE 0
        END AS "Unresolved Ticket (1–3 day) (Retail)",
        CASE
            WHEN igm."Resolved" = 'No'::text AND igm."sec_diff(open)" > 259200 AND igm."sec_diff(open)" <= 432000 THEN igm."ticket count"
            ELSE 0
        END AS "Unresolved Ticket (3–5 day) (Retail)",
        CASE
            WHEN igm."Resolved" = 'No'::text AND igm."sec_diff(open)" > 432000 AND igm."sec_diff(open)" <= 864000 THEN igm."ticket count"
            ELSE 0
        END AS "Unresolved Ticket (5–10 day) (Retail)",
        CASE
            WHEN igm."Resolved" = 'No'::text AND igm."sec_diff(open)" > 864000 THEN igm."ticket count"
            ELSE 0
        END AS "Unresolved Ticket (Above 10 days) (Retail)",
        CASE
            WHEN igm."Resolved" = 'Yes'::text THEN igm."min_diff(resolved)"::numeric / 86400.0
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS "Average Resolved Time"
   FROM analytics_insight.retail_order_igm igm
     LEFT JOIN dimension.dim_retail_seller_np snp ON igm.bpp_id = snp.seller_np::text
     LEFT JOIN dimension.dim_retail_buyer_np bnp ON igm.bap_id = bnp.buyer_np::text;

            ELSE 'DETAILED ANALYSIS OF SELLER NP - OVERALL'::text
        END AS "BPP Title",
        CASE

            ELSE 'DETAILED ANALYSIS OF BUYER NP - OVERALL'::text
        END AS "BAP Title",

            WHEN rd."Bpp ID" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(BOTH FROM rd."Bpp ID"::text) <> ''::text THEN rd."Bpp ID"::text || '(Seller NP)'::text

        END AS "BPP Subtitle",

            WHEN TRIM(BOTH FROM upper(seller_name::text)) = 'ENSTORE'::text THEN 'BITSILA'::character varying

            WHEN TRIM(BOTH FROM upper(seller_name::text)) = 'MYFITNESS'::text THEN 'MY FITNESS'::character varying
            WHEN TRIM(BOTH FROM upper(seller_name::text)) = 'NLINCS'::text THEN 'NSTORE'::character varying
            WHEN TRIM(BOTH FROM upper(seller_name::text)) = 'PRIMARCPECAN'::text THEN 'PRIMARC PECAN'::character varying
            WHEN TRIM(BOTH FROM upper(seller_name::text)) = 'SLEEPYOWL'::text THEN 'SLEEPY OWL'::character varying
            WHEN TRIM(BOTH FROM upper(seller_name::text)) = 'THESELLERAPP'::text THEN 'THE USHOP'::character varying
            WHEN TRIM(BOTH FROM upper(seller_name::text)) = 'WOWSKINSCIENCE'::text THEN 'WOW SKIN SCIENCE'::character varying
            WHEN TRIM(BOTH FROM upper(seller_name::text)) = 'NATURESNECTAR'::text THEN 'NATURE''S NECTAR'::character varying
            ELSE seller_name
        END AS seller_name,
    provider_name,
    pin_code,
        CASE
            WHEN "Sub - Category"::text = ''::text AND category IS NULL THEN 'No Category'::character varying
            WHEN "Sub - Category" IS NULL AND category IS NULL THEN 'No Category'::character varying
            WHEN "Sub - Category"::text = ''::text AND category::text = ''::text THEN 'No Category'::character varying
            WHEN "Sub - Category" IS NULL AND category::text = ''::text THEN 'No Category'::character varying
            WHEN "Sub - Category" IS NOT NULL AND category IS NULL THEN 'Others'::character varying
            WHEN "Sub - Category"::text <> ''::text AND category IS NULL THEN 'Others'::character varying
            WHEN "Sub - Category" IS NOT NULL AND category::text = ''::text THEN 'Others'::character varying
            WHEN "Sub - Category"::text <> ''::text AND category::text = ''::text THEN 'Others'::character varying
            WHEN "Sub - Category"::text = ''::text AND category IS NOT NULL THEN category
            WHEN "Sub - Category" IS NULL AND category::text <> ''::text THEN category
            ELSE category
        END AS category,

            WHEN cnt >= 0 AND cnt <= 20 THEN '     0-20'::text
